title: Diagnosis on the Denied Request and Fills at the Limit: Multiple for Overturn Authorizations
content:
For the authorization put in force after an appeal overturns a quantity limit denial on an acute migraine drug under the Utilization Management Program, the multiple applied to the drug's limit rests on the diagnosis on the denied request and on the member's paid retail fills of the drug under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit.

**Rule.**

| Diagnosis on the denied request | Paid retail fills reaching the limit both in the last month and in the month before it | Multiple applied to the limit |
|---|---|---|
| chronic migraine (ICD-10-CM G43.701, G43.709, G43.711 or G43.719) | Yes | the package's maximum exception multiple, whole (2.0 or 1.5, by package) |
| chronic migraine | No | seven eighths (0.875) of it (1.75 or 1.3125) |
| another diagnosis | Yes | seven eighths of it |
| another diagnosis | No | no change under this rule |

**Months.** Windows end on the date the authorization is put in force. The last month is the fills dated after the same day of the month one month before that date; the month before it is the fills dated within the last two months but not the last month. A month reaches the limit when the drug's paid retail fills dated in it add up to at least the drug's limit: 9 units for sumatriptan, 16 for Ubrelvy, 8 for Nurtec ODT.

*Hypothetical case:* authorization put in force on 5 July for Nurtec ODT (limit 8); the denied request carried G43.719; fills of 8 tablets on 20 June and 4 tablets on 1 June. The month before (after 5 May, up to 5 June) reaches only 4, so seven eighths applies.
